$comment: The motion contract: one entry per cue. Durations are the existing token values and are cosmetic targets, never deadlines; the opening/accent/settle split is this design's proposal and is not measured. `frontendCue` is the cue kind the event director issues (packages/presentation/src/director/director.ts at fccadf7). Every cue here is authorized by a fact the audience's own view states. The two synthetic disclosure studies are not cues and are not in this file: see synthetic-studies.json.
rules: A cue is emphasis for a fact the audience's own view already states in words. It adds no fact.
A cue changes nothing: not health, resources, turn ownership, a phase or a deadline. Nothing waits for it.
A cue plays once, for exactly its duration, and is never queued. It is withdrawn early only when the fact it belongs to changes again, or when the screen stops showing a current match.

A public cue never depends on anything private. An update that changes no public fact (the seat's own registration, a receipt, its pending commands, its private sheet opening or closing) does not withdraw, restart, renumber or delay a public cue.
Its layers take no pointer events, hold no content and cannot take focus.
No cue is played for a registration on any public surface, on any other seat's phone, or outside the open private sheet.
No cue exists for a shot, a shooter, an attack type, a block, Protection or a cause of any kind.

freshness.answers: The open items for the Designer in docs/frontend/slice-3-event-director.md on agent/frontend-motion-gallery at fccadf7, and findings R3 to R6 of the integration reviews of 6 October 2026. Frontend owns the director and the frame contract; this says what the drawing needs from them.
freshness.belonging: A public cue belongs to one public fact on the screen: the phase caption, the place of one seat, or the public health of one seat. A private cue belongs to the seat's own command. No cue belongs to a view as a whole: a seat's view also changes when only something private does.
freshness.starting: A treatment starts when its cue is issued. A renderer that first sees a cue more than startWithinMs after it was issued does not start it and shows the settled state. One window serves every kind; how long a treatment then runs is its own token duration, 120 to 700 ms.
freshness.lateness: An event that arrives more than eventLatenessMs after the view that states its fact came on screen is not a cue. A token that has stood in its new place for seconds and then drops in reads as a second move.
leaves: Its treatment has run for its duration.
Its start window passed before anything started it.
The fact it belongs to changed again: a newer place or health of the same seat, a newer phase. The newer cue takes its place.

The screen stopped showing a current match: the page is hidden, the feed is stale or unreadable, or a connecting or recovery screen is up. The settled state is shown at once and nothing is caught up afterwards.
For a private cue only: the private sheet closed. It is never played later.
neverLeavesBecause: An update that changes no public fact. On a phone the public cues, their order, their numbers and their timing are the same whatever the seat does privately at that moment; otherwise an onlooker could see a registration in a public animation that stopped short.
Its time in a frame running out while its treatment is running. A treatment that has started finishes.
freshness.preference: A public fact the cue does not belong to should not cut it either: another seat's move leaves this seat's ring to finish. The motion direction allows a renderer to cancel on any new authoritative state, so this is a preference. Cutting on a private-only update is not allowed.
freshness.together: Cues issued for one view start together. They are never played one after another: a sequence is a queue, and the later ones would be late for their facts.
freshness.cap: Status rings are small and are not capped. Token drops are: when one view moves more than maxSeatDropsPerView seats, no drop is drawn for it and the tokens are simply in their new places. A mass move belongs to a composed cue such as Final Zone entry, which is not designed yet.
freshness.kinds: phase-change is drawn: a rule under the labels. public-move draws no origin: the token drops in from above and the place it left is redrawn without it, so the cue's own origin is not used by the drawing and no path may be drawn from it.
freshness.accepted: Frontend's own choices that the design accepts as they are: a cue can be missed and a fact cannot; a private cue is never played later; nothing is cued on a stale screen; a health change is a status change with no impact; a round sweep needs the round before it; public and private cues are numbered apart.
freshness.notMeasured: The two windows and the cap are judgments made on desktop Chrome storyboards. None is measured on a device or against a real event feed.

cues.title: Select a card
cues.audience: The player's own phone, inside the open private sheet.
cues.authorizedBy: The player's own tap or key press. No event and no server fact is involved.
cues.belongsTo: The card the player picked up. Local to this device.
layers: The card lifts 3 px up and left, off its shadow.
Its ink shadow grows from 4 px to 7 px.
A focus-colored outline snaps on around it.
cues.says: Nothing about eligibility or success. The card's own status word changes to “Choosing a target”.
cues.reducedMotion: No lift. The outline and the status word appear at once.
cues.reducedEffects: Unchanged: there is no side layer to remove.
cues.fallback: The status word and the target list alone.

cues.title: Command registered
cues.audience: One seat, inside its open private sheet only. Withheld while the sheet is closed or the page is in the background.
cues.authorizedBy: An accepted receipt for this device's own command, or a COMMAND_REGISTERED event for a command the seat's own view lists as pending. One cue however many ways the device hears of it.
layers: The status word comes down as a stamp: larger and turned further, then compressed as it lands, then at rest turned 4 degrees.
A ring of halftone presses out around it as it lands and is gone by the end (drawn from tokens; the pattern-halftone tile once the public bundle has loaded).
cues.says: Nothing new. The card already reads “Registered” and “This is not a result.”
cues.reducedMotion: The stamp is simply there, with at most the 80 ms fade. No scale, turn or press.
cues.reducedEffects: The stamp lands without the halftone press.
cues.audio: None, and no vibration. The same neutral treatment for every kind of registered command.
mustNot: An impact, burst or damage mark
A different look for a different command or role

cues.title: Public token move
cues.audience: Table display, and every phone's public layer.
cues.authorizedBy: A PUBLIC_MOVE event for a view that shows the seat in its new location, where the view before showed it elsewhere.
layers: The token drops into its new place from straight above, lands with a short squash and settles.
An ink trail above it while it falls (fx-ink-trail). A picture: absent until the public bundle has loaded.
A puff at the floor contact as it settles (fx-landing-puff). A picture: absent until the public bundle has loaded.
In the table's roster, where a cell cannot travel, the location cell is underlined and the line clears.
cues.says: Nothing new. The seat is listed in its new location, and “Player N is now in <location>.” is spoken.
cues.reducedMotion: The token is in its new place at once, with at most the 80 ms fade. No drop, trail or puff.
cues.reducedEffects: The token drops and settles without trail or puff.
cues.audio: Proposed for the table display only, not produced: one soft paper tap as it lands.
mustNot: A path, arrow or slide between two rooms: the picture never implies a route or which rooms connect
Anything at the place it left other than its absence
cues.fallback: The seat is listed in its new location.

cues.title: Public status change
cues.audience: Table display, and every phone's public layer.
cues.authorizedBy: A PUBLIC_HEALTH_CHANGED event for a view that shows the seat's new health, where the view before showed another.
cues.belongsTo: The public health of one seat.
layers: The health marker itself is ringed in paper for a moment and the ring opens out and clears. The marker grows away from the name beside it and the ring stays inside the gap between them, so no word is covered.
In the table's roster the health cell is underlined and the line clears.
cues.says: Nothing new. The marker reads its new word, and “Player N is now <health>.” is spoken.
cues.reducedMotion: The marker shows its new word at once, with at most the 80 ms fade.
cues.reducedEffects: A plain fade on the marker; no ring.
cues.audio: None proposed. A sound here would be heard as “something hit someone”.
mustNot: A line to or from any other seat
A cause of any kind: the contract gives none
cues.fallback: The marker and the roster read the new word.

cues.title: New turn
cues.audience: Table display, and every phone's public layer.
cues.authorizedBy: A PHASE_CHANGED event for a view whose phase changed while its round number did not.
cues.belongsTo: The phase caption: the round and the phase on screen.
layers: A rule is ruled under the round and phase labels from the left and clears.
cues.says: Nothing new. The caption reads the new turn, and it is spoken once.
cues.reducedMotion: The labels change at once, with at most the 80 ms fade.
cues.reducedEffects: The labels change with no rule.
cues.fallback: The caption reads the new turn.

cues.title: Round transition
cues.audience: Table display, and every phone's public layer.
cues.authorizedBy: A PHASE_CHANGED event for a view whose round number went up, on a device that showed the round before.
cues.belongsTo: The phase caption: the round and the phase on screen.
layers: An ink panel with a halftone edge sweeps across the labels from the left (fx-panel-cap) and leaves to the right.
The round heading is struck in paper on the ink: larger, then down to size.
Speed lines behind the heading as it is struck (fx-speed-lines).
cues.says: Nothing new. The heading reads the new round, and it is spoken once.
cues.reducedMotion: The heading reads the new round at once, with at most the 80 ms fade. No sweep, strike or lines.
cues.reducedEffects: The labels fade in with no ink panel and no lines.
cues.audio: Proposed for the table display only, not produced: one page-turn.
mustNot: Covering the countdown or any control
Delaying the next turn: the server's phase has already started
cues.fallback: The heading reads the new round.

notProduced.title: Open private card details
notProduced.note: 220 ms layered reveal inside the private sheet. Specified in motion-direction.md; not storyboarded in this slice. No public companion effect or sound.

notProduced.title: Final Zone entry
notProduced.note: Up to 900 ms. Needs the showdown phase in the audience views, which protocol 1 does not carry.

notProduced.title: Match result
notProduced.note: Up to 900 ms entrance. Needs a terminal result in the public view, which protocol 1 does not carry.
